newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 1997 budget allocation down 1.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 1997 budget allocation down 1.2 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's budget allocation for 1997 fell 1.2 percent to 59.98 billion ringgit from 1996, Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim said on Friday.
Of the total, 42.71 billion ringgit will be allocated for operating expenditure and 17.27 billion for development, Anwar said when presenting the budget in parliament.
He said the federal government's revenue for 1997 is expected to increase to 60.78 billion ringgit.

"After taking into account loan repayments of 1.65 billion ringgit, the federal government's overall account will register a surplus of 2.45 billion ringgit for 1997 - for the fifth consecutive year we have been able to achieve a balanced budget," Anwar said.
